issues.reason: Categorical statements bars a bare (Member <group> <prop>) for a members' property (it predicates of the group-as-object), and Compound concepts gives the plural split explicitly - a fusing classifier rides the group's kind slot, a descriptive modifier distributes - and "benchmark" is in any case a NOUN modifier, which is never exposed as a property.

Measures & units defines the scale as the SURFACE dimension (a stated adjective, else the dimension noun of a measure verb/noun), and "10-year notes" names none, so "maturity" fails the "point at the words that put the atom there" test; the atom also reads as the group aggregate, since a measure on a plural does not distribute.

The Measure magnitude slot takes a native number or a ParticleFromNormal, and Fraction is defined only as the level of ProportionOf, so the atom is ill-typed - and the unit "point" is supplied from world knowledge, not the text.
The atom is false as written: it says the gain event has a price of 17/32, whereas 17/32 is the size of the change in the notes' value, and "price" is nowhere in the text.

gaps_confirmed: prenominal measure modifiers ("10-year notes") - Measure needs a scale and no rule supplies one when the text gives only a magnitude and a unit
a bond-quote bare fraction as a measured delta ("gained 17/32") - a change in value has no licensed magnitude carrier (MoreBy needs a second entity to compare against)
a proper-noun modifier inside a common-noun compound ("Treasury notes") - the fused symbol leaves the named organization with no symbol and no Name fact
new_gaps: a rate or ratio stated of a definite plural but true of each member ("notes ... yielding 4.015 percent") - the stated rule makes a plural Measure the group AGGREGATE, with no per-member form short of a distribution rule
repair_summary: Moved the classifier "benchmark" out of the barred (Member <group> <prop>) atom and into the group's kind slot as benchmark_treasury_note, with its genus retargeted to the head noun (Inheritance benchmark_treasury_note note). Deleted (Measure sk_note_1 maturity 10 year), whose scale is not in the text and which has no licensed replacement (gap recorded). Deleted (Measure sk_gain_1 price (Fraction 17 32) point), which is ill-typed in the magnitude slot, invents the unit, and predicates a price of the event; the delta has no licensed encoding, so it is removed rather than re-expressed.
notes: The repair loses "10-year" and "17/32" outright, which is the prescribed route when a confirmed issue has no licensed fix; both are recorded as gaps. The gain event, its Patient and Past, and the yield measure were left untouched.
